title: Compatible Series And Outcome Cohort Admission Registry
scope: Eight named-file cohort admission decisions and thirty-two candidate measure families tested against sixty-four compatibility checks.
interpretation_boundary: A cohort record is an acquisition contract, not a trend, score, benchmark, forecast, causal claim, or statement that qualifying observations exist. Only a human-reviewed same-entity return can add values or admit a cohort.

compatibility_dimensions.label: Stable entity identity
compatibility_dimensions.question: Does every observation resolve to the same named entity, facility, project, service, or adoption case?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Stable operating scope
compatibility_dimensions.question: Are geography, asset, service, population, receiving system, and stage boundaries explicit and compatible?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Accepted recurring operation
compatibility_dimensions.question: Is accepted repeated service, output, use, shipment, monitoring, or operation established for the same entity?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Stable measure and unit
compatibility_dimensions.question: Does the measure preserve one inspectable definition, numerator, unit, and attribution boundary across observations?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Stable denominator or exposure
compatibility_dimensions.question: Is the population, capacity, asset count, service exposure, output, customer, or other denominator stable or reconciled?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Compatible period and cadence
compatibility_dimensions.question: Are observation periods, frequency, missing periods, and partial-period treatment explicit and compatible?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Compatible method and revisions
compatibility_dimensions.question: Are collection method, calculation rule, revision history, corrections, and version changes inspectable?

compatibility_dimensions.label: Visible exceptions and alternatives
compatibility_dimensions.question: Are failures, outages, rejected units, breaks, scope changes, adverse observations, and alternative explanations retained?

compatibility_checks.label: Accepted recurring operation
compatibility_checks.question: Is accepted repeated service, output, use, shipment, monitoring, or operation established for the same entity?
compatibility_checks.basis: Required reporting creates a recurring evidence rail while one current comparable public rollup remains missing.

compatibility_checks.label: Stable measure and unit
compatibility_checks.question: Does the measure preserve one inspectable definition, numerator, unit, and attribution boundary across observations?
compatibility_checks.basis: No accepted multi-period series preserves one measure definition, numerator, unit, and attribution boundary.

compatibility_checks.label: Stable denominator or exposure
compatibility_checks.question: Is the population, capacity, asset count, service exposure, output, customer, or other denominator stable or reconciled?
compatibility_checks.basis: No accepted multi-period series supplies a stable or fully reconciled denominator or exposure basis.

compatibility_checks.label: Compatible period and cadence
compatibility_checks.question: Are observation periods, frequency, missing periods, and partial-period treatment explicit and compatible?
compatibility_checks.basis: No accepted multi-period series supplies compatible periods, cadence, and missing-period treatment.

compatibility_checks.label: Compatible method and revisions
compatibility_checks.question: Are collection method, calculation rule, revision history, corrections, and version changes inspectable?
compatibility_checks.basis: No accepted multi-period series supplies compatible collection methods, revisions, and corrections.

compatibility_checks.label: Visible exceptions and alternatives
compatibility_checks.question: Are failures, outages, rejected units, breaks, scope changes, adverse observations, and alternative explanations retained?
compatibility_checks.basis: No accepted multi-period series preserves failures, adverse observations, breaks, and alternative explanations.

candidate_measure_families.label: Passenger-service exposure

candidate_measure_families.denominator_contract: Authorized service time, vehicles, or service population
candidate_measure_families.scope_contract: Waymo, California geography, and reporting period

candidate_measure_families.label: Safety and intervention
candidate_measure_families.numerator_contract: Reportable events, interventions, recalls, or corrective actions
candidate_measure_families.denominator_contract: Passenger miles, trips, or operating hours
candidate_measure_families.scope_contract: Waymo, service scope, event definition, and reporting period

candidate_measure_families.label: Accessibility and service completion
candidate_measure_families.numerator_contract: Completed accessible trips or fulfilled requests
candidate_measure_families.scope_contract: Waymo, geography, service mode, and reporting period

candidate_measure_families.label: Complaints and service quality
candidate_measure_families.numerator_contract: Substantiated complaints, cancellations, or service failures
candidate_measure_families.scope_contract: Waymo, geography, complaint definition, and reporting period

series_break_rules: Do not combine testing-only mileage with fared passenger service.
Do not combine Waymo with other operators.
Do not merge geographies or service scopes without a bridge.
Stop comparison when event definitions, reporting obligations, vehicle fleet, operating domain, or denominator changes without reconciliation.
cohort_records.exact_next_admission_artifact: A repeated outcome series with stable identity, period, definition, method, denominator, and acceptance. A stable Waymo passenger-service series with geography, period, service exposure, rides, interventions, safety events, accessibility, complaints, cost, and compatible definitions.
